why: A GraphQL error response (a token without pull-requests: read answers 200 with an errors array) is no longer surfaced by its message. The payload guard still throws generically, so the tests fail on the missing error text; if that guard were also loosened, an in-flight issue would be promoted.
killedBy: linked pull-request retrieval refuses GraphQL errors, a missing payload, or more closing references than one page holds
reconcile command writes nothing when the pull-request read fails, rather than treating the failure as no PRs
